rule: Each beta is judged against beta 0 (SFT-v2, fp16, same job) on the N_SELECT validation diffs. A beta is eligible only if, compared with beta 0, its rate of names not in the diff and its generic rate are each at most 1 point higher, and its mean length is at most MAX_EXTRA_WORDS words longer, since length is the first thing DPO exploits. The eligible beta with the highest judge win rate (ties excluded) is chosen. It ships instead of SFT-v2 only if the lower end of that win rate's 95% Wilson interval is above 50%.
